frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's exponential disc scale length, 54.89″ (Salo et al. 2015): 334 pc. The same thickness as the image layers' slabs; for young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: HII regions of NGC 2903's bar from Popping et al. (2010): one dot per region at its catalogue position. The catalogue covers the bar zone only, so the outer disc has none.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way HII layer's pink (hou-han-hii), as M31's and M33's HII regions use. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
